title: Polynomial-time pairing of outputs
statement: Let $f$ and $g$ be polynomial-time computable functions on finite bit strings. The function sending each bit string $x$ to the encoded pair of $f(x)$ and $g(x)$ is polynomial-time computable.
replaced: If $f$ and $g$ are polynomial-time computable string functions, then so is the function sending a string $x$ to the encoded pair of $f(x)$ and $g(x)$, where both component computations may consult the original input.
